thread:
hana: morning — opened PR to consolidate localization + region availability notes for MENA & LATAM. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/2411. Added Python + Go SDK snippets, a CLI migration note, and a short paragraph on data residency. asking for copy + runtime confirmation.

josh: nice. quick ask: can the SDK examples use env var + constructor pattern instead of set_region calls? we standardize on REDWOOD_REGION in other SDKs. also include a tiny note about latency tradeoffs (nearby region vs fallback routing).

hana: yep switched to env var for node/python/go. example python snippet i added:
```
# python
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
os.environ['REDWOOD_REGION'] = 'sa-latam-1'
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'], region=os.environ['REDWOOD_REGION'])
resp = client.generate('hi')
```

marie: legal-ops: couple of legal bullets — avoid "100% stored in-region" phrasing. recommended sentence: "For Hosted plans, customer content is processed and stored in the selected region where available. For Dedicated or Private deployments, residency controls are specified in your agreement (see Data Processing Addendum: https://redwood.example.com/dpa)." also add footnote about operational telemetry and backups that may cross regions.

hana: added that wording and a footnote about logs/backups. thanks!

kevin: eng-runtime confirm: regional endpoints are api.<region>.redwood.ai (e.g., api.sa-latam-1.redwood.ai). we still accept `X-Redwood-Region` header for compatibility, but prefer region subdomain for new customers. KV + prefix cache is per-cluster; Hosted may perform read-fallback during availability events. embeddings and rerank endpoints obey region routing as well. that text is safe to land.

josh: tiny nit: show a CLI/curl migration example that maps global -> regional domain and also show header fallback. suggested curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.sa-latam-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
# older clients can still use: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: sa-latam-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

hana: added both curl examples and a short migration checklist in the PR. also updated localization footers to include region availability table per locale.

docs-bot: Docs CI: ✅ 3/3 checks passed (links, lint, preview). Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/pr-2411

marie: approved the copy from legal-ops. one more ask: add an explicit link to the Dedicated onboarding contact for customers needing contractual residency.

hana: added contact link and merged once CI green. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
